caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative metal object rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown, centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The object is symmetrical and consists of a central, upward-flaring section with a hole near the top, likely for mounting. On either side of the central section are ornate, leaf-like motifs that curve outward and then inward at their tips. Below the central section, the object narrows and extends downward, ending in a straight, rectangular tab. Two circular holes are visible—one near the top of the central section and another in the lower portion, both likely serving as attachment points. Directly below the object, the name "Max Fernekes" is handwritten in cursive, followed by the year "1938."
title: Ornamental Iron Leaf
